svg.title: F134.13 a composite structure diagram: AgentEngine, placed

g.text: F134.13 a composite structure diagram: AgentEngine, placed
a box and an arrow each
a part to a part it uses
round the six parts, through the pins
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: six parts, seven ports and six connectors become thirteen boxes and thirteen arrows in one group.
